## Setup note

- Keep the room dedicated to work: my desk stays on the interior wall; Devika’s charting surface stays on its separate wall. Preserve the clear window, door swing, and Kibo’s walking path; don’t use the room for overflow storage.
- At my 60 × 30 in desk, fit-check the larger monitor’s base/arm and viewing distance before moving equipment. Keep the display at comfortable eye level and check the afternoon glare on the right side; adjust the shade or monitor angle without blocking the window.
- Put Devika’s dock at her charting surface and route its power and device leads directly along her wall to her separate outlet. Keep her power separate from my desk power. Route my Ethernet along the baseboard as established.
- Keep every cable against its own wall/baseboard—no cables across the walking path, doorway, or between the two workstations; keep Kibo clear of both cable runs.
- Before calling it done, test both stations, confirm the chair and door clearances, and verify the window and walking path remain unobstructed.
